findings.finding: SY wraps fxSAVE ERC4626 shares. USDC/fxUSD entry converts through the fxUSD base pool then vault deposit. Output may be fxSAVE shares, base pool asset, USDC or fxUSD. Cash-like output redeems vault, calls instantRedeem and swaps the other pool leg through Curve. Preview applies instantRedeemFeeRatio; runtime can revert on insufficient assets. Owner-set supplyCap limits minting. Pool liquidity/fees and vault strategy remain dependencies.
